remark: This residential project has been approved by the Jaipur Development Authority (JDA) with sanction from the Assistant Town Planner, Deputy Town Planner, and Additional Chief Town Planner. The site area is 2205.61 sq. m. (after deductions as per bylaws) with an open area of 916.63 sq. m. and a designated green area of 331.47 sq. m. (15.02%), fulfilling the requirement of 15% for projects with BAR above 4.0. The total proposed Gross built‑up area is 16850.37 sq. m. with a permissible height of 47.07 m, while the project height is restricted to 40.96 m, ensuring compliance. A facilities area of 232.73 sq. m. (2% of BAR) has been provided as required. Parking arrangements include 104 car slots and 21 scooter slots, of which approximately 11 car slots and 2 scooter slots are earmarked for visitor parking, meeting the 10% visitor parking requirement. Additionally, 12 electric vehicle charging points have been proposed. For mortgage compliance, 10 flats (801 on the 8th floor and 901–909 on the 9th floor) with a total area of 1165.02 sq. m. have been earmarked. Thus, the project fully satisfies JDA norms regarding mortgage units, open area, facilities area, height, parking, and visitor provisions.
